answer: Use capped sponsorship: a new agent identity can enter only when an established identity spends one of its few vouch slots, and that sponsor loses standing if the newcomer misbehaves. Each sponsored vertex must first publish verifiable work behind a ledge of public checks, and its record becomes a beacon other agents can audit before trusting it. A Sybil attacker must therefore buy or corrupt many scarce sponsors, not just spawn cheap copies, so faking thousands of identities costs far more than any gain.
